newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy FS railway 2.0 trln lire bond closes early.
newsitem.headline: Italy FS railway 2.0 trln lire bond closes early.

text.p: Italy's state railway Ferrovie dello Stato's (FS) 2.0 trillion lire variable-rate domestic bond was closed on the first day of offer on Wednesday due to heavy demand, lead managers Banca di Roma and Credito italiano said.
The state-guaranteed 12-year bond, issued at par, carries a coupon equal to the six-month Rome Interbank Offered Rate (RIBOR) with a 0.10 percent annual spread.
Due date is December 3, 1996 with normal maturity on December 3, 1998. The bond is callable at par from the start of the third year and at each subsequent coupon payment date.
The public offer had been due to run from November 20-22 unless fully subscribed before the closing date.
